handoff: Review approve: AC1-AC5 (B18, B19, B21, D14) implemented and traced to tests at the S3/S1 seams; unit tier + typecheck green. One minor: retry_fresh still launches in a drifted worktree (D6 leaves running runs untouched).

findings.title: A fresh-session retry still launches an agent in a drifted worktree
findings.detail:
The hold sits only in startRun. When classifyRun routes a died/silent run to `retry`, it starts a new session (`retry_fresh` with a launch) without checking uf.skills_drift. B18 says 'start no agent step in a unit whose worktree holds bundled skills that differ', but D6 says 'Running runs ... are untouched', so this follows the agreed plan and is not blocking. Once slice 12 makes `brief` refuse on drift (B20), such a retry will hit that refusal and spend a retry.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally add `&& !uf.skills_drift?.length` to the retry launch condition, so the unit lands ready and startRun holds it with agent.skills_drift. Do it in slice 12 or a follow-up.
